author: /root/stage05_g4_contract
change: Add a pure identity projection that excludes exactly the per-source observed_at field.
Use it only for the task Root comparison and final current-source comparison.
Retain current raw rereads, native validation, full original timestamped Work material and all task, source identity, revision, digest, raw text, proposal and accepted-result bindings.
claims_not_made: No exact original native failure code was retained.
No claim is made about the cause of old ORDINARY_V02.
No owner readiness, Stage05 closure or public publication.
required_focused_observations: A fresh, admitted controller uses the actual TaskStore.source_reader and succeeds across independently changing observed_at values with unchanged source bytes.
Actual TaskStore.register_source changes raw bytes and revision; the original live G3 binding and G4 caller refuse before further native dispatch.

source_findings.finding: ApprovedSourceStore.read stamps each actual read with int(time.time()). The G4 caller compares the entire captured material against a fresh read, so observation-time drift can falsely report changed source material.

The root_review adapter uses radik_current_validation_failed for a failed check; the immutable native Root accepts only its six POST_VV hard-failure codes. This proposal does not change the adapter or native contract.
